question: From a point on the ground, the angle of elevation to the top of a building is measured as \(45^\circ\). The horizontal distance from this point to the base of the building is \(40\text{ m}\). Ignoring eye height, find the height of the building. (Unit: m)

provenance.contribution: Existing attributed explanation retained; project contribution is review and annotations.
provenance.reviewStatus: Current explanation retained and independently AI-reviewed; not teacher reviewed

solutionMethods.explanation: The building, the horizontal ground segment, and the line of sight form a right triangle. Its other acute angle is \(90^\circ-45^\circ=45^\circ\), so the two acute angles are equal. Their opposite sides are therefore equal, giving a building height of \(40\text{ m}\).
solutionMethods.label: Equal angles give equal sides
